notes:
- New: shared workspaces. Make one with a few friends, add files, and ask VORP AI about them together. Everyone sees the same answers.
- New: share your terminal. Run Claude Code on your computer and friends watch it live in their own terminal window. You choose who can type.
- Big safety update: only friends can send you files, files from others can't be faked, and downloaded programs are never opened automatically.
- Faster, more reliable sends, especially on slow connections and while VORP is minimized. Big downloads now resume after a hiccup.
- Updates now download quietly in the background and install when you're not using VORP.
- Early-access members can redeem 3 months of Pro free from Settings, Upgrade.
